_comment: Legal holidays that move a federal tax due date. IRC 7503: a deadline falling on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday moves to the next day that is none of those, and 'legal holiday' means a legal holiday in the District of Columbia (plus, for returns filed at an office outside DC, a statewide holiday of that state - not modelled here; state holidays belong to the state's own rules). DC legal holidays are the federal holidays of 5 U.S.C. 6103 plus DC Emancipation Day (DC Code 1-612.02). Observed-day rule: Saturday -> preceding Friday, Sunday -> following Monday (5 U.S.C. 6103(b); EO 11582 s.3(a); DC Code 1-612.02(b)(1)). The IRS has applied the observed day: in 2011 Emancipation Day (Sat 16 Apr) was observed Fri 15 Apr and the filing deadline moved to Mon 18 Apr. Rules, not dates, so the file never runs out; tests pin the generated dates for several years against OPM's published schedules.
